changelog: Initial release: hosted agent mailbox API at api.agentpost200.com — register, inbound POST, poll/ack, reply_to, optional forward.
summary: AgentPost200 (api.agentpost200.com): hosted agent mailbox with live endpoints — register for API key and inbound POST URL, receive without hosting, poll/ack, two-way reply_to, optional webhook forward, blocklists. Senders POST without an account. Not email/IMAP AgentPost (agentpost.no or similar).
